jobs.title: Security Officer Job at Trinity Valley School in Fort Worth
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
About Trinity Valley School:Founded in 1959 and named for the Trinity River that flows nearby, Trinity Valley School is an independent, nonsectarian, college-preparatory school which seeks students of above-average to superior ability who will contribute to the diversity of the student body and enrich the School community.
Enrollment includes more than 1,000 students in pre-kindergarten through grade 12 on a 75-acre campus in Fort Worth, Texas.
Families choose TVS for its deep commitment to developing curious minds and lifelong learners, as well as for its strong sense of community.TVS provides extraordinary opportunities for students to develop empathy and inclusivity as leaders and to stretch themselves in academics, athletics, visual and performing arts, and signature programs in outdoor experiential education and global education.Trinity Valley School recruits and retains exemplary faculty whose skill in the classroom is complemented by their positive contributions to other programs and endeavors within the school community.
These stellar faculty inspire excellence and actively promote the mission and philosophy of the school by modeling for their students the resiliency, flexibility and persistence that embodies the TVS school motto, Per Aspera ad Astra (Through Difficulty to the Stars!).Trinity Valley School is committed to attracting and retaining exceptional faculty and staff by offering highly competitive salaries; fully paid employee health, disability, and life insurance; employee dental insurance; TIAA-CREF 403(b) plan with immediate vesting; vision insurance; flexible spending accounts; ample funding for professional development; tuition reimbursement for coursework toward advanced degrees; and more.Trinity Valley School actively seeks to recruit and hire faculty and staff whose diverse experiences and backgrounds are reflective of our global community.
We are deeply committed to serving our mission and advancing institutional goals for equity, inclusion, and community.Position Description:Trinity Valley School is seeking a full-time Security Officer beginning January 2024.
Role and Responsibilities: TVS Security Officers are the front line of protecting the School community and managing risk in a manner respectful of the School's core values, culture, and climate.
Officers help to provide an environment that ensures student, faculty, and visitor safety while supporting the School's mission.Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Performing basic security services, greet all persons entering campus, patrol campus, control access gates, monitor multiple cameras, perform traffic control, perform registered sex offender checks, operate access control systems, operate building alarm systems, submit incident reports, secure campus nightly, assist with school emergency drills, and in the event of a medical emergency, render first aid.Knowledge, Experience, and Skill Requirements:The ideal candidate willHave prior experience as a security officer.Support fully our missionRecognize, embrace, and engage in efforts to enhance diversity, equity, and inclusion.Exemplify personal and professional integrity.Work collaboratively with TVS faculty and staff.Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.Be proficient with Microsoft and Mac software.Successfully complete background screening.Application Requirements:Qualified candidates should complete an online application for employment and attach a résumé by visiting Trinity Valley School Career Opportunities.
You will receive an email confirming receipt of your application.
For questions or general inquiries about this job opportunity, please contact:Kevin Kinley, Director of SecurityPhone: (817) 321.0100Email: kinleyk@tvs.orgTrinity Valley School is an equal-opportunity employer.
It is our policy to provide equal opportunity in all aspects of employment practices.
Trinity Valley School does not discriminate against any qualified employee or applicant for employment due to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected category under federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Copy of Experienced Level III Commissioned Security Officer (School Campus Assignment)
jobs.description:
Overview

Valor Force (#C19105) is a private security and investigations company committed to providing a quality product with exceptional service. Our motto is simple, "Put the needs of our clients first." Our services are customized to meet and exceed the needs of our clients as we are trained to protect while maintaining a professional work ethic, ensuring our clients are safe. We are a security company that protects with integrity and excellence. Corporate events, security consultation, church services, and personal protection are a few of the areas where we provide Valor protection.

1485 Richardson Dr., Suite 170

Richardson, TX 75080

Job Skills / Requirements

About the Opportunity

We are seeking professional, disciplined, and experienced Level III Commissioned Security Officers to support school-based safety and protection. This role is ideal for officers who take pride in their appearance, communication, and tactical readiness — and who want to work in a mission-driven environment that values professionalism and leadership.

If you want to make a meaningful impact on campus safety while working alongside educators, families, and law enforcement, this is the position for you.

What You’ll Do

As a commissioned officer assigned to a school campus, you will:

  • Serve as a visible, trusted security presence for students and staff
  • Conduct interior and exterior patrols
  • Respond to incidents, disturbances, and emergencies
  • Maintain strong communication and de-escalation standards
  • Prepare accurate and timely incident and daily activity reports
  • Partner closely with school administrators and local law enforcement
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and situational awareness
  • Uphold the highest standards of professionalism and accountability

This is a position where your demeanor and decision-making matter as much as your tactical skill set

Minimum Requirements

To be considered, candidates must have:

  • Active Texas DPS Level III Commissioned License
  • 21+ years of age
  • High School diploma or GED
  • Valid Texas driver’s license
  • Reliable transportation and a working mobile phone
  • Strong firearm handling and safety proficiency
  • Ability to pass background screening and physical fitness assessment
  • Strong writing, communication, and observation skills
  • Ability to work independently with professionalism and integrity

Disqualifiers (No Exceptions)

  • Felony conviction within 10 years
  • Class A Misdemeanor within 5 years
  • Class B Misdemeanor within 2 years
  • Any domestic/family violence conviction
  • Any open charges or deferred adjudication for felony or Class A/B misdemeanor

Required Duty Gear (Officer-Provided)

  • Service-caliber duty firearm (Glock, SIG Sauer, S&W, H&K — 9mm/.40/.45)
  • Level III retention holster no dropdown or thigh holster
  • Full duty belt setup
  • OD Green tactical pants
  • Flashlight, handcuffs, and other standard duty accessories

Preferred Experience

We strongly value applicants with:

  • Prior military or law enforcement background
  • Previous school security or SRO-style experience
  • Advanced firearm proficiency
  • Demonstrated report writing excellence
  • Strong interpersonal, conflict-resolution, and leadership skills

Schedule & Physical Standards

  • Must be able to work all shifts, including weekends or holidays if required
  • Must maintain a clean-cut, professional appearance
  • Ability to walk, stand, run, climb, or sit for extended periods

jobs.title: School Security Professional
jobs.description:
At Tier One, we believe every child deserves to feel safe enough to learn, and every teacher deserves to teach without fear. As an Armed School Security Officer, you'll be the professional who makes that possible, the person students know by name, the calm presence on an ordinary day, and the one everyone depends on when it matters most.

If you've worn a badge, served in the military, worked in security, or simply feel called to protect others, you already understand that real security is about earning trust, not just carrying a firearm.

What You\'ll Do
Working under the direction of your School Security Supervisor, you will:

Protect students, faculty, staff, visitors, and school property through a highly visible, professional security presence.

Serve as the primary security professional assigned to your campus.

Build trusted relationships with students, families, educators, administrators, and local law enforcement.

Foster a welcoming, safe, and respectful campus environment.

Enforce applicable laws, school policies, and security procedures with sound judgment and professionalism.

Monitor visitor management, access control, surveillance systems, and campus activity.

Identify, investigate, and respond to suspicious activity or security concerns.

Coordinate emergency drills and maintain state compliance.

Serve as the campus subject‑matter expert for emergency planning, preparedness, and training.

Deliver age‑appropriate presentations on safety and emergency preparedness.

Support responding law enforcement and emergency personnel during critical incidents.

Prepare accurate reports, documentation, and administrative records.

What You\'ll Need

Minimum 21 years of age.

High school diploma or GED (college coursework or degree preferred).

Ability to obtain and maintain a Texas Level III Commissioned Security Officer License.

Ability to legally possess and carry a firearm while performing assigned duties.

Ability to pass all background investigations, drug screening, and licensing requirements.

Excellent communication, report‑writing, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to meet Tier One\'s physical and professional performance standards.

Who Thrives Here
The best people in this role are calm under pressure, emotionally mature, and dependable. Retired or former law enforcement officers, military veterans, and licensed Texas Commissioned Security Officers all do well here, as do newcomers ready to earn their license through our academy. What they share is sound judgment, genuine respect for others, and a commitment to protecting children and serving their community.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation as a W-2 employee

Medical, dental, vision, life, and critical‑care insurance

Monday-Friday schedules aligned with school calendars (based on assignment)

Holidays and summers off. These breaks are unpaid but ideal anyone who values that time with family & community

Company‑paid uniforms and equipment

Paid training and continuing education

FREE Tier One Security Academy for qualified candidates

Opportunities for advancement

A culture built on professionalism, service, accountability, and teamwork

No License? We\'ll Help You Earn It.
We believe character matters more than credentials. If you have the desire to serve but don\'t yet hold a Texas Level III Commissioned Security Officer License, qualified candidates may attend our FREE five‑day Tier One Security Academy — intensive, instructor‑led training from experienced law enforcement and military professionals. There is no tuition or training cost, our curriculum exceeds minimum licensing standards, and upon successful completion and satisfaction of all state requirements, Tier One pays your Texas Level III licensing fees.

About Tier One
Founded in 2018 in Dallas, Tier One Holdings was built by senior leaders from military, law enforcement, and intelligence backgrounds who believed private security could operate at a higher standard. Today we are one of Texas\'s most trusted providers of integrated security services, protecting schools, businesses, places of worship, and critical infrastructure across the state. Backed by more than 200 years of combined military, law enforcement, and public safety leadership, our recruiting, training, and performance standards exceed state minimums — because the people we protect deserve nothing less.

Beyond our contracts, Tier One proudly supports organizations dedicated to the rescue, recovery, and aftercare of survivors of child sex trafficking — a cause that reflects why we do this work.

Join a Mission That Matters
Some jobs offer a paycheck. This one offers purpose. If you believe protecting children is one of the highest callings in public service, we invite you to join the Tier One family.
